situations.headline: Celsius Resources (CLA): MHL's 40% MMCI stake foreclosed by Equinaire via credit-bid auction, company disputes and pursues legal/arbitration remedies

changelog.entry: stage-2 assessment: Celsius Resources (CLA): MHL's 40% MMCI stake foreclosed by Equinaire via credit-bid auction, company disputes and pursues legal/arbitration remedies (interest 6, risk 8)

thesis.text: Celsius Resources' core asset value is now contingent on the outcome of a contested foreclosure of its 40% MMCI interest by Equinaire; near-term catalyst is the BIR tax clearance window (6-8 weeks) during which Celsius will seek judicial and arbitral relief to block transfer registration, making this a binary litigation-driven special situation rather than a compounder.
